rendered:
The three papers that report lithium leaching from nickel-containing NMC cathodes into a liquid are:

1. Reference [24] by Li et al. reports lithium leaching from NMC into water.
2. Reference [31] by Jung et al. reports lithium leaching from NMC811 into water.
3. Reference [34] by Loeffer et al. reports lithium leaching from NMC into water.

Only Reference [24] by Li et al. gives a number for the leaching in the main text, which is 3-4 wt% lithium leached from NMC into water after one week.

prompt.system: You answer questions about a collection of documents, using only what they contain. The texts of the {n} documents most related to the question, extracted from their PDFs, are below. A question may be about one of them, several, or all. If the documents do not hold what the question asks, say so.

expect: ethylene glycol (cssc-2020): Li content 1.015 to 0.993 (p5.L65-68); Cyrene (susmat-2020): ether groups attract lithium, numbers only in Table S1, not in the text (p5.L19-26); water (ensm-2020): NMC 811 leached ~3 wt% Li after one week (p5.L62-63)
